doctorApproval.description: Sent when a doctor profile is approved
doctorApproval.subject: Welcome to DrStethos — your doctor profile is approved
doctorApproval.text:
Dear {{profileName}},

Congratulations! Your {{profileType}} profile has been successfully verified and approved on DrStethos.

Open your dashboard: {{dashboardLink}}

If you need assistance, contact support@drstethos.com.

Warm regards,
Team DrStethos
doctorApproval.html:
Congratulations! Your {{profileType}} Profile Has Been Approved

Dear {{profileName}},

We’re delighted to inform you that your {{profileType}} profile has been successfully verified and approved on DrStethos.

You are now officially part of a rapidly growing digital healthcare ecosystem designed to empower doctors, hospitals, and medical professionals with enhanced visibility, trust, and patient engagement tools.

Go to Your Dashboard

From here, you can manage your profile, update information, and explore upcoming features that will further strengthen your online presence and streamline engagement with patients.

If you need assistance, our support team is always here to help. Contact us at support@drstethos.com.

Warm regards,
Team DrStethos

doctorRejection.subject: Update on your DrStethos doctor profile verification
doctorRejection.text:
Dear {{profileName}},

Thank you for submitting your {{profileType}} profile for verification on DrStethos.

After review, we were unable to approve your profile at this time.

Reason: {{rejectionReason}}

Please update your profile and resubmit when ready. Contact support@drstethos.com if you need help.

Thank you for your understanding.
Team DrStethos
doctorRejection.html:
Update on Your {{profileType}} Profile Verification

Dear {{profileName}},

Thank you for submitting your {{profileType}} profile for verification on DrStethos. We appreciate the time and effort you invested in completing your details.

After a thorough review, we were unable to approve your profile at this time. Below is the reason provided by our verification team:

Reason: {{rejectionReason}}

We encourage you to review the above details and update your profile accordingly. Once the necessary corrections or documents are provided, you may resubmit for verification at any time.

If you need clarification or further assistance, our support team will be happy to help. Contact us at support@drstethos.com.

Thank you for your understanding.
Team DrStethos
